term-and-conditions.title: Terms and Conditions
term-and-conditions.content:
Terms & Conditions of Service

Welcome to RangoElectronics.com. By browsing, purchasing, or using services on this website, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms and conditions.

Pricing and Availability

All prices are listed in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT) and are inclusive of applicable VAT unless stated otherwise. Stock availability is updated continuously, but in rare cases of stock depletion, our team will contact you promptly with alternate options or immediate refund.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
faq.content:
Frequently Asked Questions

Are the products sold on Rango Electronics 100% genuine?

Yes. All products are 100% authentic, brand-new, and sourced through official manufacturer and authorized distributor channels.

How do I avail 0% EMI?

Select the EMI option at checkout or contact our support team. We partner with over 28 commercial banks to provide zero-interest EMI from 3 up to 36 months.

Do you deliver outside Dhaka?

Yes, we deliver to all 64 districts across Bangladesh through secure insured courier networks.

How can I track my order?

Visit our Track Order page and enter your Order ID and contact phone number for real-time delivery status.
